proclaim--verb.def: To announce something publicly and officially.
proclaim--verb.ex: They proclaimed a day of rest.

hard-working--adj.def: Putting a lot of effort into work.

conservation--noun.def: The protection of nature or of old buildings.

downward--adj.def: Moving or pointing towards a lower place.
downward--adj.exTr: Satışlar aşağı doğru bir eğilim gösteriyor.

refreshments--noun.def: Light food and drinks served at an event.

electron--noun.def: A tiny particle that moves around an atom's centre.
electron--noun.ex: An electron carries a negative charge.

calculation--noun.def: The act of working out an amount with numbers.

sweatshirt--noun.def: A thick cotton top worn for warmth or sport.
sweatshirt--noun.ex: He pulled on a grey sweatshirt.

attain--verb.def: To succeed in reaching a level or a goal.

housework--noun.def: The cleaning and cooking done at home.

supporter--noun.def: A person who supports a team or a cause.

wither--verb.def: To become dry and die, said of plants.
wither--verb.ex: The flowers withered in the heat.

boldly--adv.def: In a confident and brave way.
boldly--adv.ex: She boldly asked for a raise.

owing--adj.ex: There is money owing on the bill.

entertainer--noun.def: A person whose job is amusing an audience.

specialize--verb.def: To concentrate on one particular subject or skill.
specialize--verb.ex: The shop specializes in old maps.

diagram--noun.def: A simple drawing that explains something.
diagram--noun.ex: Study the diagram on page two.

proverb--noun.def: A short old saying that gives advice.

outward--adj.def: Relating to the outside, or going away from a place.

fluent--adj.def: Able to speak a language easily and well.

similarly--adv.exTr: İkinci test de benzer şekilde bitti.

preservation--noun.def: The act of keeping something in good condition.
preservation--noun.ex: The preservation of the mosaics is costly.

decrease--noun.def: A fall in the amount or the number of something.
decrease--noun.ex: There was a decrease in traffic.

decrease--verb.def: To become less, or to make something less.

abundant--adj.ex: Fish were abundant in the bay.

cultivate--verb.def: To prepare land and grow crops on it.

visually--adv.def: In a way that relates to seeing.

evenly--adv.def: In equal amounts or in a regular way.

favorable--adj.def: Showing approval, or good for your plans.

modify--verb.def: To change something slightly to improve it.

teammate--noun.def: A person who plays on the same team as you.

soothe--verb.def: To make someone calmer or pain less severe.
soothe--verb.ex: Warm milk soothes a sore throat.

vary--verb.def: To be different in different situations.
vary--verb.ex: Prices vary from shop to shop.

molecule--noun.def: The smallest unit of a substance made of atoms.
molecule--noun.ex: A water molecule has three atoms.
molecule--noun.exTr: Bir su molekülünde üç atom var.

mathematician--noun.def: A person who studies or teaches mathematics.

remainder--noun.def: The part that is left after the rest is used.

remembrance--noun.def: The act of remembering someone who died.
remembrance--noun.ex: They held a day of remembrance.

rearrange--verb.def: To change the order or the time of things.

dazzle--noun.def: Brightness that makes it hard to see.
dazzle--noun.ex: The dazzle of the snow hurt his eyes.

campsite--noun.def: A place where people put up tents.
campsite--noun.ex: The campsite is near the river.

safeguard--noun.def: A rule or a device that protects against danger.
safeguard--noun.ex: The law is a safeguard for tenants.

discourage--verb.def: To make someone less likely to do something.

thriller--noun.def: An exciting film or book about crime or danger.
thriller--noun.ex: She reads a thriller every week.
thriller--noun.exTr: Her hafta bir gerilim romanı okuyor.

calculator--noun.def: A small machine that does sums.

oily--adj.def: Covered with or containing a lot of oil.

irritate--verb.def: To annoy someone, or to make skin sore.

comma--noun.def: The mark used to separate parts of a sentence.
comma--noun.ex: Put a comma after the name.

format--noun.def: The way something is arranged or presented.
format--noun.ex: Send the file in this format.

format--verb.def: To arrange text or prepare a disk for use.

preschool--adj.def: For children who are too young for school.

minimize--verb.def: To make something as small as possible.

astronomer--noun.def: A scientist who studies stars and planets.
astronomer--noun.exTr: Gök bilimci bütün gece gözlem yaptı.

ecosystem--noun.def: All the living things in an area and their surroundings.

measurement--noun.def: The size or amount found by measuring.

motivate--verb.def: To make someone want to do something.

vacancy--noun.def: A job or a room that is available.

diligence--noun.def: Careful and steady effort in work.

graphics--noun.def: Pictures and designs, especially on a computer.

loudspeaker--noun.def: A device that makes sound louder for a crowd.

arithmetic--noun.def: The part of mathematics dealing with simple sums.

interval--noun.ex: There is a short interval now.

geology--noun.def: The study of rocks and the earth's structure.

willingness--noun.ex: Her willingness to help was clear.

breathless--adj.ex: He arrived breathless at the top.

anti--adj.ex: They took an anti war position.

stricken--adj.def: Badly affected by trouble or illness.
stricken--adj.exTr: Felakete uğrayan köyün yardıma ihtiyacı vardı.

curriculum--noun.def: The subjects taught in a school or a course.

possessive--adj.def: Wanting to keep someone or something for yourself.
possessive--adj.ex: He is possessive about his tools.

excitedly--adv.def: In a way that shows strong happy feeling.

furthest--adv.def: At or to the greatest distance.

encyclopedia--noun.def: A book or website with facts about many subjects.
encyclopedia--noun.ex: Look it up in the encyclopedia.

stripe--noun.def: A long narrow band of colour.
stripe--noun.ex: The flag has a red stripe.

second-hand--adj.def: Already owned or used by someone else.

second-hand--adv.def: By buying something that was used before.

overjoyed--adj.ex: She was overjoyed at the news.

spectator--noun.def: A person who watches an event or a game.

consequently--adv.def: As a result of what happened before.
consequently--adv.exTr: Kar yağdı; sonuç olarak okul kapandı.
